mapper.select: select u.user_id from sys_user u join gw_user_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and upper(p.user_type)='STUDENT' for update
select assignment_id assignmentId,student_id studentId from gw_assignment where workstation_id=#{workstationId} and ended_at is null for update
mapper.sql: r.record_id recordId,r.student_id studentId,r.assignment_id assignmentId,r.score,r.grade, r.explanation,r.issue_description issueDescription,r.photo_urls photoUrls,r.status, room.room_name roomName,w.workstation_no workstationNo,r.create_time createTime
mapper.select: select from gw_inspection_record r left join gw_room room on room.room_id=r.room_id left join gw_workstation w on w.workstation_id=r.workstation_id where r.student_id=#{studentId} and r.status in ('VERIFIED','ARCHIVED') order by r.record_id desc
select from gw_inspection_record r left join gw_room room on room.room_id=r.room_id left join gw_workstation w on w.workstation_id=r.workstation_id where r.record_id=#{recordId} for update
mapper.update: update gw_inspection_record set score=#{score},grade=#{grade},admin_comment=#{comment},update_time=now() where record_id=#{id} and status in ('VERIFIED','ARCHIVED')
mapper.sql: p.penalty_id penaltyId,p.student_id studentId,p.assignment_id assignmentId,p.workstation_id workstationId, p.room_name roomName,p.workstation_no workstationNo,p.reason,p.started_at startedAt,p.until_at untilAt, p.status,p.ended_at endedAt,p.end_reason endReason,u.nick_name studentName
mapper.select:
select from gw_penalty p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.student_id
and p.student_id=#{studentId} and exists(select 1 from gw_user_profile f where f.user_id=p.student_id and f.mentor_id=#{mentorId}) order by p.penalty_id desc
select from gw_penalty p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.student_id where p.penalty_id=#{penaltyId}
select from gw_penalty p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.student_id where p.penalty_id=#{penaltyId} for update
select penalty_id penaltyId from gw_penalty where workstation_id=#{workstationId} and status='ACTIVE' for update
mapper.update: update gw_penalty set status=#{status},ended_at=now(),end_reason=#{reason} where penalty_id=#{id} and status='ACTIVE'
update gw_penalty set until_at=#{until} where penalty_id=#{id} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select penalty_id from gw_penalty where status='ACTIVE' and until_at is not null and until_at <= now() order by penalty_id
mapper.insert: insert into gw_message(user_id,title,content,destination,event_key) values(#{userId},#{title},#{content},#{destination},#{eventKey}) on duplicate key update event_key=values(event_key)
mapper.select: select message_id messageId,title,content,destination,read_at readAt,create_time createTime from gw_message where user_id=#{userId} order by message_id desc
select count(*) from gw_message where user_id=#{userId} and read_at is null
mapper.update: update gw_message set read_at=coalesce(read_at,now()) where message_id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
update gw_message set read_at=now() where user_id=#{userId} and read_at is null
mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' and r.role_key in ('admin','college_admin')
mapper.sql: a.appeal_id appealId,a.student_id studentId,a.mentor_id mentorId,u.nick_name studentName, a.target_type targetType,a.target_id targetId,a.original_score originalScore,a.revised_score revisedScore, a.reason,a.status,a.mentor_comment mentorComment,a.admin_comment adminComment, a.create_time createTime,a.mentor_reviewed_at mentorReviewedAt,a.admin_reviewed_at adminReviewedAt
mapper.select: select count(*) from gw_appeal a where a.status=#{status} and exists(select 1 from gw_user_profile p where p.user_id=a.student_id and p.mentor_id=#{mentorId})

select from gw_appeal a left join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.student_id
and a.student_id=#{studentId} and exists(select 1 from gw_user_profile p where p.user_id=a.student_id and p.mentor_id=#{mentorId}) order by a.appeal_id desc
select from gw_appeal a left join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.student_id where a.appeal_id=#{appealId} for update
mapper.update: update gw_appeal set status=#{status},mentor_comment=#{comment},mentor_reviewed_at=now() where appeal_id=#{appealId} and status='PENDING_MENTOR'
update gw_appeal set status=#{status},admin_comment=#{comment},admin_id=#{operatorId},admin_reviewed_at=now(),revised_score=#{revisedScore} where appeal_id=#{appealId} and status='PENDING_ADMIN'
mapper.select: select application_id businessId,student_id studentId,status from gw_mobile_application where application_id=#{applicationId}
select return_id businessId,student_id studentId,status from gw_return_application where return_id=#{returnId}
